admission.formula: E165's admission value (the largest of the tile's three frozen 95% upper peaks on aifoundry2) - (M9.a2_q140l.zeros_board_w - card 0's E84 zeros p800) - 0.05 x (M9.a2_q140l.P800_w - M9.a2_q140l.zeros_board_w)

card_term.kappa0_source: docs/reports/data/2026-11-01-e118-two-clock-card0/README.md (table 'Three cards at 600 MHz now': E118 on card 0 against E72 on aifoundry2)
card_term.level: the session's own zeros anchors, every counted burst at >= 795 MHz, per format, referred to each tile's die starts by m9_a2's kT, in full (E170.md)

card_time.subset: passes 1, 2, 4 and 5 (the first two of each half): --subset, --cap 25 in a 30-minute slot

identity.identity: release 1.4.0, BL1 0.22.0, BL2 0.22.0, PMIC 1.6.1, minions 0.25.1 (E84 amendment A1; E114's start read; E118's continuity)

reference.source: tools/claims-v3/e165/predictions-e165.json reference.e2e.pinned (Q140(l)'s 42 end-to-end pinned cells) and reference.heat (112 residuals)

rules.E170-B: |mean(board - primary)| <= 0.5 W and rms <= 1.0 W: PASS, else FAIL (rank 2's pinned lines on a second governed card)
rules.E170-C: every launch of every BURST run has a C record reading PASS (it decides which runs count)
rules.E170-F: pinned clock rms at or below the 97.5% point of the bootstrap of the 42 pinned clock errors
rules.E170-H1: die rise rms against the bootstrap of the burst heat law's 112 residuals
rules.E170-H3: coverage of the die-rise band (+-1.406 C)
rules.E170-M1: rank 1 on card 0: d = rms(M9 D errors) - rms(M6 D errors) over the admitted priority-1 new kinds, each model's D600 through the same card term; paired 95%: BETTER if the upper end < 0, WORSE if the lower end > 0, else NOT RESOLVED
rules.E170-S: no safety stop, no sampler line under 590 MHz in any counted run, no peak at or above 62 W: PASS, else FAIL (the day's behaviour)
rules.E170-W: pinned board, rms(board - primary) at or below the 97.5% point of the bootstrap of the 42 pinned board errors: PASS, else FAIL
rules.E170-W3: coverage of the primary's board band (+-1.264 W): inside >= the 2.5% point of Binomial(n, 0.95)
rules.E170-X0: the median over scored non-anchor tiles with a2 burst_D >= 5 W of measured D / (a2 burst_D): PASS if its 95% interval holds kappa0, else FAIL
